| `activate-from-zone` | implemented | ability | 2 | Allow an activated ability to declare an activation zone (discard / hand / void) and be usable from there (RECUR / EXHUMATION / RETIRE). The sourceInZone condition already exists; the activation path (getActivatableAbilities, cost payment, source lookup) assumes zone==='play'. Prestige Inversion, Spatchcocking; pervasive later. |
| `activate-while-facedown` | implemented | ability, condition | 0 | Allow an ActivatedAbility with activationZone covering 'play' AND a new condition { type:'sourceIsFaceDown' } to be used while source.faceDown && zone==='play' (bypass the 'a face-down card's abilities cannot be activated' assert for that ability only). 'Reveal this card' in the cost is cosmetic; the card stays face-down unless an effect flips it. 'PETTY VENGEANCE — COST: Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pay 1. ...' (Fired Hand); Vorpal Sword SNICKER SNACK. |

## Parity gaps

_Printed clauses deliberately left unmodelled — each needs a large engine / format refactor. The affected cards are still `verified` for their in-scope parts._

| Gap | Scope | Cards | Summary |
|---|---|--:|---|
| `card-ignores-source-class` | medium | 1 | A card that cannot be picked by, and is not affected by, cards of a given type. |
| `cross-faction-rule-override` | medium | 1 | A faction that replaces one of the OPPONENT's faction rules with its own. |
| `double-sided-faction` | large | 2 | EPIC faction cards have two sides and flip between them mid-game. |
| `mixed-starting-resources` | medium | 2 | Starting-resource rules more expressive than `{ count, names?, stapleOnly? }` — a chosen count, a mix of specific + free picks, face-down non-resource cards, or an opponent-topped-up-to-match clause. |
| `opponent-may-pay-to-counter` | medium | 2 | A tactic EXTRA COST lets a chosen player pay to peek + fizzle the card before it resolves. |
| `search-and-develop-draw-interception` | medium | 2 | An optional pay-to-substitute layer over another player searching their deck, or over a Develop Rule draw. |
| `showdown-multiplayer` | xlarge | 2 | The multiplayer "Showdown" format — 1 Villain vs. N Heroes, shared Temptation Pile, a separate Hero deck, Allegiance cards, and faction values that scale with X = the number of opponents. |

### `card-ignores-source-class`

- **Clause:** This card ignores all rules text on locations. (this card cannot be picked by locations and any effects from locations do not affect this card.) — Parkour Hoodlum
- **Needs:** Scoped targeting immunity (cannotBePicked keyed on the picking source's card type) plus a general 'effects from <type> don't affect this card' filter across dealDamage / createModifier / etc. — a per-source-type shield with no current hook.
- **Cards:** Parkour Hoodlum (Shade of the Devoured Emperor)

### `cross-faction-rule-override`

- **Clause:** The Knitting Coalition — HIDDEN INFLUENCE ("Your opponent ignores their faction's STARTING DRAW rule and uses this card's rule instead.") and DEVELOP RULE — PULLING STRINGS ("Your opponent ignores their faction's DEVELOP RULE.").
- **Needs:** A layer that lets one in-play faction card suppress / substitute specific sub-rules of another player's FactionDefinition (setup draw, restore, develop), resolved before setup and re-checked each turn.
- **Cards:** The Knitting Coalition (Seed 3)

### `double-sided-faction`

- **Clause:** INTERNAL CONFLICT / CONSTANT IN-FIGHTING — "At the end of your turn, flip a coin. If you win, turn this card over. (Only the face-up side is active.)"
- **Needs:** A double-sided CardDefinition model + an engine action that swaps the in-play faction card's active FactionDefinition to its reverse. Touches setup, getFactionDefinition, and every restore/develop/threshold path.
- **Cards:** Counter-Imperial Army (Seed 3), Imperial Army (Seed 3)

### `mixed-starting-resources`

- **Clause:** The Society of Magical Propriety — "Any 1 resource, Any 1 card (if it's not a resource, put it into play face-down)." The Union of Unextraordinary Miners — MONEY FOR NOTHING ("choose a number for X ... You start with X staple resources and 1 Deception. Your opponent starts with ... enough staple resources so that both players have the same number of starting resources.").
- **Needs:** Extend FactionDefinition.setup.startingResources to a small program: a chosen variable, per-slot constraints (specific name | any staple | any card→face-down), and an opponent-normalisation rule. Currently modelled as a flat `count: 2`.
- **Cards:** The Society of Magical Propriety (Seed 3), The Union of Unextraordinary Miners (Seed 3)

### `opponent-may-pay-to-counter`

- **Clause:** EXTRA COST: Pick a player. That player may pay 2. If they do, look at the top card of your deck then terminate this card. (Study Disturbance) / Any opponent may pay 3. If they do, look at the top 3 cards ... then terminate this card. (Tedious TriAdic Truculence)
- **Needs:** A pre-stack player-buyout interrupt: at deploy time, before the tactic goes on the response stack, offer a cost to a chosen player whose payment cancels the deploy and runs a small peek effect. Distinct from the response stack (the buyer is not responding, and the tactic never resolves). Touches deployCard / the response-window opener.
- **Cards:** Study Disturbance (Shade of the Devoured Emperor), Tedious TriAdic Truculence (Shade of the Devoured Emperor)

### `search-and-develop-draw-interception`

- **Clause:** If a player would search their deck you may pay 1. If you do, draw a card and then that player searches their deck instead. (Golden Charm) / If you would draw a card as part of your Develop Rule, you may put a card voided by this card into its owner's hand instead. (Arcane Escrow)
- **Needs:** A replacement-style hook on "a player searches their deck" and on "a Develop Rule draw" — neither is a replaceable event today (search is not an event at all; the develop draw is internal to chooseDevelop). Low value (2 cards, each a secondary clause).
- **Cards:** Arcane Escrow (Shade of the Devoured Emperor), Golden Charm (Shade of the Devoured Emperor)

### `showdown-multiplayer`

- **Clause:** The Evil Alliance / Slightly Less Evil Alliance — ENTICEMENT, DARING GAMBIT, GIVE IN TO TEMPTATION, SPRING FORTH MY BURLY PROTECTOR!, YOUR TRUE COLORS ARE REVEALED, and "INFLUENCE = 15 + 10*X" / "repeat X-1 times".
- **Needs:** N-player game state, a Temptation Pile + Hero-deck zone, Allegiance-card tracking, and X-scaled faction values. The engine is 2-player only; this is a different game mode. In 2-player these clauses collapse to X = 1 (already handled) or are inert.
- **Cards:** Slightly Less Evil Alliance (Seed 3), The Evil Alliance (Seed 3)

- **Golden Charm** (Shade of the Devoured Emperor) — Author SERAPHIM FUSION; the search-interception clause is niche (2 cards) — candidate wontImplement-partial / parity note. [merge: the search-interception clause is a parity gap (search-and-develop-draw-interception); the rest of the card is in scope.]

[author: TACTICAL-in-hand authored; 'ignores all rules text on locations' (cannot be picked by / not affected by locations) is the parity gap card-ignores-source-class.] [author: TACTICAL-in-hand authored; 'ignores all rules text on locations' (cannot be picked by / not affected by locations) is the parity gap card-ignores-source-class.]
